response.original_title: Behind The Curtain of Milk Man & The Big Band
response.overview: This television special originally broadcast on East Tennessee PBS on December 29, 2025. Presenting a film by Jacob Hale — Behind of Curtain Milk Man & The Big Band - a new, hour-long documentary chronicling the journey of Knoxville, Tennessee's Milk Man & The Big Band. What began as an inside joke among a small group of friends eventually grew into a full-time musical endeavor - culminating in a headlining performance at the historic Bijou Theatre. This film takes viewers behind the scenes of a 21-piece ensemble built on community, friendship, and perseverance.
response.title: Behind The Curtain of Milk Man & The Big Band
